questions.q: What does a for loop do?
options: Runs its body once per item in a list (or anything iterable), with the loop variable taking each value in turn
Only works with numbers, never with dictionaries
Automatically sorts a list before processing it
Runs exactly once, regardless of the list's length
questions.explain: for is the loop you'll use constantly — processing one row at a time is most of what a data engineering script does.

questions.q: When would you reach for a while loop instead of a for loop?
options: When you don't know in advance how many times you'll need to loop, like reading API pages until there's no more data
while loops cannot be used with conditions
while loops are always interchangeable with for loops with no difference
Only when working with strings, never with numbers
questions.explain: while keeps running as long as its condition stays true, which suits open-ended repetition.

questions.q: What does break do inside a loop?
options: Skips only the current iteration and continues the loop
Has no effect inside a loop
Stops the loop entirely, right where it is
Restarts the loop from the beginning
questions.explain: break exits the loop completely, unlike continue which just moves to the next iteration.

questions.q: What does continue do inside a loop?
options: Stops the loop entirely
Deletes the current item from the list
Pauses the loop until manually resumed
Skips the rest of the current iteration and moves on to the next one
questions.explain: continue is how the validation example skips an invalid trip without stopping the whole loop.

questions.q: In the valid_trips example, what determines whether a trip gets added to the valid_trips list?
options: Trips are added in random order with no validation
Whether it passes both the fare_amount and passenger_count checks, using continue to skip invalid ones
Only the first trip in the list ever gets added
Every single trip gets added regardless of validity
questions.explain: This combines Lesson 16's conditions with this lesson's loop to filter a real list of trips.
